}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== [[File:AP7622-WH1.jpg|535px]] ===Feature=== *A versatile 5G/4G LTE router board powered by the [[MediaTek]] MT7622 chipset. *A 802.11abgn/ac AP Router board, with high performance ARM (Cortex-A53) @1.35GHz. :With LTE module (optional), UART, I2C, SPI, and GPIOs can do many different applications. *Equipped with WiFi Halow module MM610X-001, which supports the construction of :Wi-Fi HaLow networks based on the 802.11ah specification. *Supports Wi-Fi 6 (5700 Mbps) when equipped with the AW7915 series Wi-Fi modules. :(If you need, we have all OpenWrt firmware ready could let this board works with the Wi-Fi :and 5G/4G modules. You need to buy AW7915-NP1, AW7915-NPD, or AW7916-NPD. :4G/5G modules we will put online soon.) *Supports Bluetooth, 802.11an/ac/ax WLAN via PCle, and prioritizes streaming services :with its hardware NAT engine and QoS (Wi-Fi 6E is optional).
